answer: Triage every agent by proven scarce stake, not claimed identity, so a jade badge of verified compute-hours gates priority access. Escalate each newcomer through a river of graduated trust, where cheap accounts get low-weight votes and costly bonds earn throughput. A sybil swarm must then fund many sonnet-priced bonds and burn real resources per fake identity, capping attack scale by cost, though colluding wealthy actors can still buy influence.
